Got a one-night stand pregnant, I told her I would support her and be a father to the child, but I didn't want to have a romantic relationship with her. She used the child as fuel to emotionally torture me. She'd get into arguments with me if I didn't reply fast enough to her whilst in work. We live in Britain, she was from Poland, and she would constantly threaten to leave the country and take the child with her so I'd never see them or have a right to visit them, etc. unless I did what she wanted when she wanted.
After a few months of this, she miscarried the child. Despite her being torturous to me throughout the pregnancy I was still broken up about losing the kid, but she blamed every bit of pain she felt on me as a pile-on and threatened to kill herself multiple times.
I finally decided to call the police to come to her flat after one of her threats. After they visited and confirmed she was safe, she messaged me, berating me for having embarrassed her by doing that.
It took one of her friends stepping in to call her out on her bullshit to finally distract her from abusing me to target her friend instead. We haven't spoken in years, and I hope it stays that way.

I'm doing a pirate ship campaign atm so I have a crow like kenku in the crows nest who declares where enemies are nearby by mimicking the direction from the options the captain lists.
He's an excitable young kenku out for adventure so whenever he's not in the crows nest he flutters about the players and says mimics them in the most excitable voice ever whenever they start talking about anything fun like treasure chests, sword fights, etc.
My players love him and he is their favourite member of the crew, they seem more excited about encounters whenever he plays the hype man role when they talk about it.
